content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (medium severity, audit).**

The audit right binding us sits in Article V(IV)(b) at p0073, with cost allocation at p0064. Most of the mechanics are actually favourable:

- **Auditor:** independent CPA / Audit Professional, selected by mutual agreement — better than our preferred position
- **Scope:** limited to "appropriate accounting records" — no access to our systems, so no walk-away exposure there
- **Cost:** borne by Licensor unless a discrepancy over 5% is found — matches preferred exactly

The failure is **frequency**: the clause has no cap whatsoever. Licensor may issue an unlimited number of written requests, each of which we must accommodate within 30 days. That fails even the fallback (once per year) and edges into walk-away territory ("unlimited audits").

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** a single in-line proviso on p0073 adding a one-audit-per-twelve-months cap, plus business-hours and confidentiality conditions — the smallest edit that reaches the preferred position, leaving the auditor-selection and cost-allocation bargain untouched.

One lesser point noted in the rationale rather than flagged: there is no express advance-notice period, but the written-request plus 30-day window gives adequate lead time, so it did not warrant a separate deviation.
